background: Citigroup is the holding company of the most international of the large US banks, with services, markets, banking, wealth and US personal banking as its main lines, and a multi-year restructuring behind it.
synthesis: As the holding company its ratings sit below the bank's: A- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at BBB+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 2 Dec 2015. Consolidated capital is on the weak side against US peers: CET1 of 11.8% and leverage of 5.2% are both below the peer median, with leverage down 0.4 points since 30 Sep 2025, while LCR of 117% is at the median. The flagged news is conduct: the newest item, on 3 Sep 2026, is a UK fine for Russia sanctions breaches, with earlier items on the same fine, none of it large against the balance sheet.
